meta.title: A non-surrogate call on a staggered event is refused
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: the documented correct behaviour is a refusal, but the case checks only that the app does not crash (it records today's behaviour)
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (staggered) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Not allowed to bid on this product”, and never with a server error.
